card.name: Words inside historical and biblical lists
card.fires_on: Small linking or listing words (and, of, with, commas) and some verbs in old-world or biblical passages about materials, offerings, artillery or ritual objects. The next word is often a concrete material or object.

modes.label: Lists of materials
modes.description: The word is a comma or 'and' inside a list of offerings or materials.
modes.example: skins<<,>> wood, gems, oil and spices.

modes.label: Links before an object
modes.description: A linking word or verb sits just before a concrete material or ritual object.

modes.label: Military or ordinal modifiers
modes.description: A number or ordinal before a noun in a historical account.
modes.example: The artillery was generally<< six>>-pounder brass guns

card.writes: Weakly favors concrete material and object nouns like wire, dots and bul-, with no strong theme.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in old biblical or historical lists of materials and objects.
